subtitle: AI Operating System
description: Complete roadmap from Foundation to full AI Operating System
honesty_note: Pipeline execution %, feature coverage %, and roadmap progress % are always reported separately. They are never merged into one misleading number.

milestones.name: Foundation Release
milestones.description: Core platform with web UI, owner authentication, dashboard, chat (built-in engine), project builder, 21-stage pipeline, AI worker manager, memory timeline, reports, settings, roadmap, and full design system.
what_is_implemented: Owner first-time setup with encrypted credentials
Dashboard with live stats and quick launch
Chat with NEXUS — built-in pattern-matching engine, SSE streaming
Project Builder with 21-stage pipeline and live console
AI Workers page — all 22 agents, CPU/memory metrics
Reports with pipeline stats and system health
Settings: AI provider (built-in / OpenRouter / Ollama / LM Studio)
Design docs: UI_DESIGN.md, COMPONENT_MAP.md, SCREEN_FLOW.md, THEME_SYSTEM.md, ANIMATION_SYSTEM.md
what_is_NOT_implemented: Real LLM calls in pipeline stages (stubs/templates only)

milestones.name: Real Intelligence
milestones.description: Connect real LLM providers so every pipeline stage produces genuine, goal-specific code, architecture and documentation.
features: OpenRouter API integration (OPENROUTER_API_KEY via Replit Secrets)
Each of 21 pipeline workers uses real LLM
Model selector per worker in Settings
Project detail page with full pipeline output
Pipeline visualisation with animated stage flow

milestones.name: Voice & Presence
milestones.description: NEXUS comes alive with voice input, spoken responses and the animated splash screen from the brand sheet.
features: Web Speech API — speech to text in chat
Real-time audio waveform (matches brand sheet design)
Animated splash screen on first load

milestones.name: Build Anything
milestones.description: NEXUS generates Android, iOS, desktop and game projects — not just web apps.
features: Project digital twin system (architecture + code + docs saved together)

milestones.name: Financial Intelligence
milestones.description: Track, analyse and report on all revenue streams. Every financial action requires Founder approval.
features: Bank details stored encrypted (never in git)
Founder approval required for ALL financial actions

milestones.name: Social Media Command
milestones.description: Manage Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp Business and more — always with Founder approval.
features: Every post/action requires explicit Founder approval
Never assumes monetisation — reports only verified earnings

milestones.name: Marketing Engine
milestones.description: Full marketing campaign creation with AI-generated visuals, videos and ad copy.
features: All campaigns require Founder approval before publishing

milestones.name: Customer Intelligence
milestones.description: NEXUS reads, categorises and acts on customer feedback, reviews and support requests.
features: Email and chat management (Founder-approved replies only)

milestones.name: Full AI Operating System
milestones.description: The complete vision: NEXUS manages the Founder's entire digital empire — software, business, finance, marketing, customers — all under one private, intelligent platform.
features: App ecosystem management (every app NEXUS ever built)
Automated daily/weekly/monthly reporting across all domains

milestones.name: Beyond Screens
milestones.description: Expansion into robotics, smart home, AR/VR and IoT — NEXUS as a physical world operating system.
